chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), who said:

When Rasūl Allāh (صلى الله عليه وآله) was taken on the Ascension, Jabrāʾīl brought him to a place and then left him there. So he said to him, "O Jabrāʾīl, are you leaving me in this state?" He said, "Go on, for by Allah, you have indeed set foot in a place that no human being has ever set foot in, and no human being walked in before you."

key_terms.تُخَلِّينِي: you leave me or withdraw from accompanying me
key_terms.جَبْرَئِيلُ: the angel Jibrīl who accompanied the Prophet to a certain point
key_terms.رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muḥammad (صلى الله عليه وآله)
key_terms.عُرِجَ: was taken up in the heavenly ascent
key_terms.مَكَانٍ: a place or station reached during the ascent
key_terms.وَطِئْتَ: you trod or set foot upon

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the unique station of Rasūl Allāh (صلى الله عليه وآله) during the Miʿrāj?
ai.summary: This narration describes a moment in the Miʿrāj of Rasūl Allāh (صلى الله عليه وآله) when Jabrāʾīl reaches a limit and leaves him to proceed further alone. It highlights the unique rank and divinely granted station of the Prophet (صلى الله عليه وآله) in a realm no human had reached before him.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Hammad Bin Usman, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When there was an Ascension (Mi’raj) with Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, Jibraeel<sup>as</sup> ended up with him<sup>saww</sup> to a place, and he<sup>as</sup> isolated from him<sup>saww</sup>. So he<sup>saww</sup> said to him<sup>as</sup>: ‘O Jibraeel<sup>as</sup>! You<sup>as</sup> are isolating from me<sup>saww</sup> upon this state?’ So he<sup>as</sup> said: ‘Carry on, for by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, you<sup>saww</sup> are treading in a place in which no person has trod upon and no person has walked in it before you<sup>saww</sup>’.
